items.title: Poundland collapses putting 11,000 jobs at risk
items.summary: The discount chain has fallen into administration after its owners failed to find a buyer.

items.title: Why has Poundland collapsed and what happens next?
items.summary: The retail chain has collapsed just one year after being bought for £1 by an American firm.

items.title: US announces new tariff proposals on EU, China, and other trade partners
items.summary: The new levies would hit many of America's biggest trading partners, including China and the EU.

items.title: Wife drugged and raped by husband asked police if she was to blame, mass sexual offence trial hears
items.summary: The woman told a court suggestions she was 'pretending to be asleep' were 'absolute rubbish'.

items.title: Thirty-one killed in massive fire as fuel tanker crashes on Cairo highway
items.summary: Another 21 are injured after the tanker reportedly overturns on a busy ring road in the Egyptian capital.

items.title: Duran Duran guitarist Andy Taylor dies aged 65
items.summary: The musician, who co-wrote some of the band's biggest hits, had been treated for prostate cancer.

items.title: Images of asteroid targeted to test Earth's defences reveal stadium-sized crater
items.summary: The asteroid's surface was transformed after a spacecraft was deliberately crashed into it four years ago

items.title: Gordon Ramsay to host Top Gear as show revived after Flintoff crash
items.summary: Ramsay will take the driving seat alongside as yet unnamed co-presenters when the show starts filming next year.
